title: PANDA ML Package
summary: A machine-learning package for integrating predictive models into the PanDA (Production and Distributed Analysis) grid-computing system, covering data preprocessing, model training, and prediction pipelines. Its requirements.txt pins copulas, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and sdv, but no code in the repository actually imports or calls any of them.
evidence: requirements.txt: copulas==0.12.0, ctgan==0.10.2, rdt==1.13.1, sdmetrics==0.17.1, sdv==1.17.2; no matching code usage found
needs: Dependencies for the whole SDV family are declared but no pattern hits were found in code, so it's unclear whether any of these packages are actually invoked or just listed as unused/transitive requirements.
